description: Details required by Condition 3 (submission of details - b) Elevation (1:10) and section (1:5) drawings of new windows with details of mouldings in section (1:1). New windows shall be made of solid timber and hand painted, with integral glazing bars; c) Elevation (1:10) and section (1:5) drawings of new doors with details of mouldings in section (1:1); d) Elevation (1:10) and section (1:5) drawings of external cornices; e) Plan (1:10) and section (1:5) drawings of rooflights; f) Elevation (1:10) and section (1:5) drawings of new railings and balcony. Railings and balconies shall be painted black and be so maintained; and j) Notwithstanding the approved drawings, elevation, plan and section drawings of entrance door and portico/surround at no.13) of planning permission PP/25/04591 (Variation of conditions 2 (approved drawings) and condition 32 (restricted area of terrace) of planning permission 24/04739 to allow design refinements to the scheme, including: enlarged windows to rear elevation of No 12 to match the aperture sizes at neighbouring No 11; raised front outrigger to Nos 3 & 4 at second floor level; and enlarged rear terraces at GF level to include the removal of the existing balustrades creating a larger rooftop terrace to Nos 2-4)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
